WILL CONSIDER THE AIRPORT CLEARANCE WHICH AN AIRCRAFT RECEIVES ON 
THE GROUND AT ITS DEPARTURE AERODROME TO BE THE ROUTE PORTION OF THE 
OCEANIC CLEARANCE. ALTITUDE AND SPEED ASSIGNMENT WILL OCCUR PRIOR TO 
ENTRY INTO THE NEW YORK CENTER OCEANIC CTA. AS IS THE CURRENT 
OPERATING PROCEDURE, UNSOLICITED EN-ROUTE ROUTE, ALTITUDE OR SPEED

THE LAST ASSIGNED ROUTE, ALTITUDE AND SPEED ARE TO BE MAINTAINED AND 
SHOULD BE CONSIDERED YOUR NEW OCEANIC PROFILE. HAVING RECEIVED ALL 
THREE COMPONENTS, THE REQUIREMENT TO RECEIVE AN OCEANIC CLEARANCE 
WILL HAVE BEEN MET.

AN AIRCRAFT HAS FILED AN FPL FROM MDSD TO EDDF. THIS WOULD TAKE THE
